title: Oshi No Ko
desc: Dr. Gorou Amamiya is shocked when a pregnant star, Ai Hoshino, appears at his countryside clinic. After secretly delivering Ai’s baby, Dr. Goro is murdered by her obsessive stalker. Reborn as Ai’s new child, Aquamarine Hoshino, he embarks on a quest to help his mother rise to the top. What can a child do about the dark underbelly of the entertainment industry? And what if disaster strikes?
author: Doga Kobo
